payload.title: File:Romualdo Formation pterosaur diversity.jpg
payload.description_html: Romualdo Formation pterosaur diversity – The climax of Araripe pterosaur times. We emphasize that the coexistence of the taxa is merely illustrative, since the lack of geological context for most pterosaur fossils from the Araripe Basin prevents a precise inference of contemporaneity.
